Frequently Asked Questions

What is Holstein 2ABS3508?

Holstein 2ABS3508 is an abs wheel speed sensor. It is listed for 13 year-and-engine configurations from 2016 to 2022, including Honda on AutoFactsDB.com.

Which vehicles does Holstein 2ABS3508 fit?

Holstein 2ABS3508 fits 2022 Honda Insight 1.5L L4 ELECTRIC/GAS, 2021 Honda Civic 1.5L L4 Turbocharged, 2021 Honda Civic 2.0L L4, 2020 Honda Civic 1.5L L4 Turbocharged and 2020 Honda Insight 1.5L L4 ELECTRIC/GAS, among 13 listed configurations.

Does Holstein 2ABS3508 fit a Honda?

Yes. Holstein 2ABS3508 is listed for Honda applications from 2016 to 2022. Examples include 2022 Honda Insight 1.5L L4 ELECTRIC/GAS, 2021 Honda Civic 1.5L L4 Turbocharged and 2021 Honda Civic 2.0L L4.
